relations.object: Guy's Hospital Medical School, University of London
relations.evidence: he studied medicine at Guy's Hospital Medical School), University of London, where he excelled... After graduation in 1866

relations.subject: Stephen Wootton Bushell
relations.evidence: He was awarded the degree of Doctor of Medicine (MD) from the University of London on 13 May 1868.

relations.subject: Stephen Wootton Bushell
relations.evidence: After graduation in 1866, he worked as a house surgeon at Guy's Hospital

relations.subject: Stephen Wootton Bushell
relations.evidence: and then in 1867 he worked as a resident medical officer at Bethlem Royal Hospital.

relations.subject: Stephen Wootton Bushell
relations.evidence: Bushell was offered a position as physician to the British Legation in Beijing, China... except for a few periods of leave, he remained there for the next thirty-two years. He finally retired and returned to England in 1900

relations.subject: Stephen Wootton Bushell
relations.evidence: He also worked with Dr. George F. Kunz and Heber R. Bishop in writing producing the catalog of the Bishop Collection of Jade at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in 1906.
